title: Snapshot readiness
summary: An authored trace of a frontend invoke and two Rust return branches, not compiler control flow.

sections.title: Request snapshot
sections.body: refresh invokes the constant snapshot command with ready.

sections.title: Ready?
sections.body: The handler tests the ready argument.

sections.title: Ready value
sections.body: The true branch produces the owned ready string.

sections.title: Pending value
sections.body: The else branch produces the owned pending string.

connections.label: snapshot
connections.rationale: The frontend command literal matches the registered root handler. This is not proof of runtime invocation.

connections.label: true
connections.rationale: The if ready branch returns the ready string.

connections.label: false
connections.rationale: The else branch returns the pending string.
